Industrial Plots

100+

Plot Acquisition Through Authority

Government-Allotted Plots via Three Major Authorities

We have deep working knowledge of allotment procedures, pricing schemes, and documentation requirements across all three authorities — making your plot acquisition smooth and completely risk-free.

GNIDA
Greater Noida Industrial Development Authority

GNIDA is the primary authority for Greater Noida's industrial zones. We assist in navigating e-auction, scheme-based allotment, and direct allotment processes for plots in Ecotech, Site B, Site C, and other designated sectors.

  • Assistance in GNIDA industrial plot scheme application & e-auction
  • Plot sizes from 200 sqm to 40,000 sqm across different zones
  • Freehold and leasehold plot identification based on your needs
  • Guidance on premium vs standard allotment pricing
  • Documentation for lease deed, registry & possession letter
  • Name transfer, sub-leasing, and mortgage NOC services
  • Extension of Time (EOT) for construction compliance
Ecotech I · II · III · Site B · Site C · Kasna
UPSIDA
Uttar Pradesh State Industrial Development Authority

UPSIDA manages several industrial estates in and around Greater Noida. We assist manufacturers and industrialists from initial inquiry through allotment letter to final possession — including instalments and transfers.

  • End-to-end UPSIDA plot application and allotment assistance
  • Identification of UPSIDA estates near Greater Noida
  • Guidance on UPSIDA's instalment-based payment plans
  • Plot transfer, sub-division, and mutation assistance
  • Coordination for building plan approvals under UPSIDA norms
  • Factory licence and compliance guidance post-possession
  • Resale and secondary market assistance for UPSIDA plots
Surajpur · Kasna · Sahibabad · Ghaziabad Belt
YEIDA
Yamuna Expressway Industrial Development Authority

YEIDA's Yamuna Expressway corridor is rapidly developing with excellent connectivity to Delhi, Agra, and Noida International Airport (Jewar). We help investors secure plots at the right price and timing in this high-growth zone.

  • YEIDA industrial plot scheme tracking and timely application
  • Plots near Jewar Airport for logistics & manufacturing
  • Sector 28, 29, 32, 33 industrial zone coverage
  • Plot booking, allotment letter & instalment management
  • FAR utilisation guidance and building plan sanction support
  • Coordination with YEIDA for possession and registry
  • Investment advisory for YEIDA's upcoming industrial phases
Sector 28 · 29 · 32 · 33 · Jewar Airport Corridor
Construction on Industrial Plots

Build Your Facility — RCC Structure or Industrial Shed

Once your plot is secured, we construct your factory or warehouse — choosing the right structural type based on your industry, load requirements, and budget.

🏢
Structure Type 01
RCC Structure Construction

Reinforced Cement Concrete (RCC) structures are ideal for multi-storey industrial buildings, heavy machinery units, and facilities requiring long-term durability. We execute complete RCC construction — foundation to roof slab — compliant with BIS standards and authority building bylaws.

Type
Framed RCC
Best For
Heavy Industry
  • Architectural & structural drawings and authority sanction
  • Deep foundation — isolated footings / raft as per soil test
  • RCC columns, beams, slabs — M25/M30 grade concrete
  • Brick masonry infill walls, plaster, and waterproofing
  • Overhead water tank, septic tank, sewage layout
  • Electrical conduit, substation room, DG room provision
  • Internal roads, compound wall, security cabin
  • Completion certificate and occupation certificate support
🏭
Structure Type 02
Industrial Shed Construction

Pre-engineered and conventionally built industrial sheds are the fastest and most cost-effective solution for warehousing, light manufacturing, assembly, and logistics. Column-free large spans with quick construction timelines for faster operational readiness.

Type
Steel / PEB
Best For
Warehouse / Light MFG
  • Pre-Engineered Building (PEB) and conventional steel options
  • Column-free spans up to 40m for maximum flexibility
  • RCC plinth beam and anchor bolt foundation
  • Colour-coated GP sheet roofing with ventilators and skylights
  • AC sheet / sandwich panel sidewalls with insulation
  • Industrial mezzanine floor for office and stores within shed
  • EOT crane gantry provision for manufacturing requirements
  • Fire-fighting provision, exhaust fans, natural lighting design

Our Process

How We Execute a Construction Project

🔍
Step 01
Site Survey & Requirement Analysis

We visit your plot, conduct soil investigation if needed, understand your operational requirements, and prepare a detailed scope of work and cost estimate.

📐
Step 02
Architectural & Structural Design

Our empanelled architects and structural engineers prepare detailed drawings — floor plans, elevations, sections, and structural calculations tailored to your plot and industry norms.

✅
Step 03
Building Plan Sanction from Authority

We submit drawings to the relevant authority and follow up actively until the building plan is sanctioned and construction permission is officially issued.

🏗️
Step 04
Construction Execution

We mobilise our construction team, procure quality materials, and begin phased construction — foundation, superstructure, roofing, and finishing — with regular quality checks and updates.

🏁
Step 05
Handover & Completion Certificate

After construction, we coordinate the authority inspection, obtain the completion certificate, and hand over the fully ready facility with all documentation in place.

Six Government Departments, One Point of Contact

We do not just submit files — we follow through until the certificate or NOC is in your hands. Our team has established working relationships with officials across all six departments.

PCB
Pollution Control Board — U.P.

Complete PCB compliance management for green, orange, and red category industries operating in the region.

  • Consent to Establish (CTE) application
  • Consent to Operate (CTO) application
  • Annual CTO renewal

Labour Dept.

Full-service labour law compliance — from initial factory registration to annual renewals and inspection support.

  • Annual factory licence renewal

  • Amendment of factory licence (workers/area)

  • Shops & Establishment Act registration
